project.description: Acrylic Nails selling website, users should be able to make a account using gmail, and buy products, track their order, receive confirmation email | Customers who want to browse and purchase press-on nails, and an admin (myself) to manage products, inventory, and orders.

qa.question: What is the name of your project?
qa.answer: Nails By M | User login/sign up page, home page showing best selling products, product catalog page, contact us page, home page should include review snippets. User should be apple to add/remove products in card and checkout

qa.question: Describe the project and what it should do.
qa.answer: Acrylic Nails selling website, users should be able to make a account using gmail, and buy products, track their order, receive confirmation email | Customers who want to browse and purchase press-on nails, and an admin (myself) to manage products, inventory, and orders.

qa.question: What type of website is it?
Who will use it? (e.g. customers, admin)
qa.answer: Target customers are female between age of 14-40 | Pink themed website, easy trendy ui, payment option should include credit/debit

qa.question: List the main features you need (comma separated).
qa.answer: User Login/Signup, Product Catalogue, Product Cart, Payment getaway | They must work well., User Profile Management, Order History and Tracking, Wishlist Functionality

qa.question: Which of those features are must-have for the first launch?
qa.answer: 1 and 2 | User profile management(signup/login) and order placement and tracking

qa.question: Any outside services needed? (payments, email, maps...)
qa.answer: Online payment gateway, email notifications, courier services | Make them functional

qa.question: Any technology or framework preference? (e.g. Django)

objectives: Create a user-friendly acrylic nails selling website.
Enable users to create accounts and manage their profiles.
Facilitate product browsing, selection, and purchasing.
Provide order tracking and email notifications.

functional_requirements.feature: Payment getaway | they must work well.

non_functional_requirements: Website should have a pink theme and trendy UI.
Payment options must include credit/debit cards.
Website should be responsive and accessible.
risks: Potential delays in payment gateway integration.
User data security and privacy concerns.

user_stories.i_want: to log in or sign up
to add products to my cart
user_stories.so_that: I can purchase multiple items at once
I can securely pay for my orders
I can update my personal information

user_stories.i_want: to view my order history and track my orders
user_stories.so_that: I can keep track of my purchases

user_stories.i_want: to add products to a wishlist
user_stories.so_that: I can save items for future purchase

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the login/signup page
acceptance_criteria.when: I enter valid credentials and click the login button
acceptance_criteria.then: I should be redirected to my account dashboard

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the login/signup page
acceptance_criteria.when: I enter invalid credentials and click the login button
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see an error message indicating the credentials are incorrect

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the login/signup page
acceptance_criteria.when: I choose to sign up and fill in the required information
acceptance_criteria.then: I should receive a confirmation email after successful registration

acceptance_criteria.given: I have an existing account
acceptance_criteria.when: I click on the 'Forgot Password' link
acceptance_criteria.then: I should receive an email with instructions to reset my password

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged into my account
acceptance_criteria.when: I navigate to the product catalogue
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see a list of available products

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the product catalogue page
acceptance_criteria.when: I filter products by category
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see only products that match the selected category

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the product catalogue page
acceptance_criteria.when: I search for a specific product
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see the product that matches my search query

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the product catalogue page
acceptance_criteria.when: I click on a product
acceptance_criteria.then: I should be taken to the product detail page

acceptance_criteria.given: I am viewing a product detail page
acceptance_criteria.when: I click the 'Add to Cart' button
acceptance_criteria.then: The product should be added to my shopping cart

acceptance_criteria.given: I have added products to my cart
acceptance_criteria.when: I view my cart
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see all the products I have added

acceptance_criteria.given: I have products in my cart
acceptance_criteria.when: I remove a product from the cart
acceptance_criteria.then: The product should no longer appear in my cart

acceptance_criteria.given: I have products in my cart
acceptance_criteria.when: I proceed to checkout
acceptance_criteria.then: I should be taken to the payment page

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the checkout page
acceptance_criteria.when: I enter my payment details and submit
acceptance_criteria.then: The payment should be processed securely

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the checkout page
acceptance_criteria.when: I enter invalid payment details
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see an error message indicating the payment failed

acceptance_criteria.given: I have successfully completed a payment
acceptance_criteria.when: I check my order history
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see the new order listed

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the checkout page
acceptance_criteria.when: I choose to cancel the payment
acceptance_criteria.then: I should be redirected back to my cart without any charges

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged into my account
acceptance_criteria.when: I navigate to the profile management page
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see my current personal information

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the profile management page
acceptance_criteria.when: I update my personal information and save changes
acceptance_criteria.then: My updated information should be saved successfully

acceptance_criteria.given: I have updated my profile information
acceptance_criteria.when: I log out and log back in
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see my updated information in my profile

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the profile management page
acceptance_criteria.when: I attempt to save incomplete information
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see an error message indicating the required fields

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged into my account
acceptance_criteria.when: I navigate to the order history page
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see a list of my past orders

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the order history page
acceptance_criteria.when: I click on an order
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see the details of that order

acceptance_criteria.given: I have orders in my history
acceptance_criteria.when: I track an order
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see the current status of that order

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the order history page
acceptance_criteria.when: I refresh the page
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see the most up-to-date order status

acceptance_criteria.given: I am logged into my account
acceptance_criteria.when: I view a product detail page
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see an option to add the product to my wishlist

acceptance_criteria.given: I have added products to my wishlist
acceptance_criteria.when: I navigate to my wishlist page
acceptance_criteria.then: I should see all the products I have saved

acceptance_criteria.given: I have products in my wishlist
acceptance_criteria.when: I remove a product from the wishlist
acceptance_criteria.then: The product should no longer appear in my wishlist

acceptance_criteria.given: I am on the wishlist page
acceptance_criteria.when: I click on a product in my wishlist
acceptance_criteria.then: I should be taken to the product detail page
